meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你把 NanoClaw 接上 Resend 邮箱:补上并注册邮件通道、安装组件、写入账号配置,再把你的邮箱设为 owner 并绑给一个 AI 助理,发一封问候邮件;之后你可以用邮件和该助理来回对话。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加 Resend 邮箱通道、用邮件和 AI 助理异步回复,或在 /setup 流程里要求配邮件时。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱,并给我的邮箱发一条问候。
say.note: 会先要你粘贴 API key、webhook 密钥等。

say.text: 用 Resend 加一个邮件通道,让指定的 AI 助理能用邮件回复我。
say.note: 它会确认由哪个助理负责回复你的邮件。

say.text: 在 /setup 里加上 Resend,把我的邮箱设为 owner。
say.note: 配置完成后会发给该邮箱一封问候。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can connect NanoClaw to email via Resend: it adds and registers the channel, installs the dependency, saves account settings, makes your address the owner, binds it to an assistant, and sends you a hello email.
howto.when_en: Trigger it when you ask to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw, want an assistant to reply asynchronously by email, or need email configured during /setup.

say_en.text: Help me connect NanoClaw to Resend email and send a greeting to my inbox.
say_en.note: It first asks you to paste your API key and webhook secret.

say_en.text: Add a Resend email channel so my AI assistant can answer by email.
say_en.note: It also asks which assistant handles your replies.

say_en.text: In /setup, add Resend and make my email address the owner.
say_en.note: Once configured, it sends a greeting to that address.
